declarations.name: AuiColorPicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI ColorPicker: `<aui-color-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label (accessible name of the trigger or the value field).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; a hidden input submits the hex value.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Show the value without allowing changes (thumbs stay focusable).

inputs.name: alpha
inputs.description: Show the opacity slider; the value becomes #rrggbbaa.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Popup from a trigger button, or the panel in place.

inputs.name: presets
inputs.description: App-supplied preset swatches with optional spoken names.

inputs.name: recent
inputs.description: App-supplied recent colors (the app keeps the list).

inputs.name: eyeDropper
inputs.description: Offer the screen eyedropper where the browser has the EyeDropper API.

inputs.name: clearable
inputs.description: Show a clear button that sets the value to null.

inputs.name: contrastWith
inputs.description: Background color for the WCAG contrast hint (ratio and AA/AAA verdict).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation of the hex value; return a message to mark it invalid.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icons for the error, eyedropper, and clear button.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Text format of the value field: 'hex', 'rgb', or 'hsl'.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of messages and value text.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: The value changes while dragging, with a key, or on any commit: { value, validity }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The value was committed (pointer release, key, swatch, typed text, eyedropper, clear): { value, validity }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Close the popup; focus returns to the trigger by default.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the trigger (popup) or the area thumb (inline).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear validation state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Slider for hue and opacity; the saturation and brightness area is one role=slider thumb whose aria-valuetext names both values; the popup is a non-modal dialog opened by a button with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded.

limitations: The eyedropper exists only where the browser has the EyeDropper API (Chromium-based browsers); elsewhere the button is not shown.
